title: Cannot use get_tree_string() in an instanced node to access the global scene tree
body:
### Tested versions

I tested 4.6.2.stable and 4.6.3.stable. They are all can reproduce this.

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (Intel Corporation; 31.0.101.5522) - Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 125H (18 threads) - 15.52 GiB memory

### Issue description

I don't know if this was intentionally designed, a script in an instanced scene calling get_tree_string() will only retrieve the scene tree inside the instanced scene, not the current root scene tree.
A script in an instanced scene calling get_tree_string() will only retrieve the scene tree inside the instanced scene, not the current root scene tree.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/80d2d5e3-4de4-4d9a-abb3-fb0445ff3900

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a scene and add some nodes randomly (you can also not add any, this is just for a more intuitive view)
2. Write a script in the root directory of the scene that calls get_tree_string().
3. Create another scene and instantiate the previous scene into it.
4. Run this scene. You will find that get_tree_string() only retrieve the nodes inside the instantiated scene!

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No configuration is needed; it can be reproduced with just an empty project.
[test_get_tree.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28150210/test_get_tree.zip)
